Confirming preliminary root cause: when an autoscale surge happens our pooling scheduler was aggressively reclaiming idle pre-warmed slots while new instances were coming up. A race condition in the allocation window caused transient lack of ready capacity for short high-frequency bursts, producing elevated tail latency and retries.

Mitigation path we validated in staging:
- Introduce a 90s warm-standby hold window for recently started nodes during scale events (prevents immediate reclamation).
- Slightly increase ephemeral slot timeout to 45s during scale events.
- Add a quick health-check gate so only nodes that pass KV/cache warm checks are routed traffic.

We can push an opt-in configuration for affected Dedicated pools within 24 hours to reduce customer impact while we harden scheduler logic for a full fix (target 2 weeks). I recommend informing customers of an opt-in warm-standby mode plus an operational playbook.

Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer
